head_commit.message:
Freeze exhaustive independent original-policy validation for all 983 R119-C keys

Precommit the full known-catalogue key list, 64-cell Fraction enclosure protocol, independent primitive implementation closure and complete input hashes before validation D executes. Preserve A/B/C scientific sources, observations and clocks. Economic contrast signs are reported without an adoption pass criterion.

Also confine the historical audit no-lazy-fetch guard to its audit step so the declared sparse checkout can complete; preserve the first checkout failure and its actual job records.
